purpose: Reproducible Rubrova integration pilot; not production approval.

dockerCompose.note: Official MyCompany-specific Compose bundle. The SHA-256 is pinned from the official versioned download; inspect service image tags and digests before launch.

modules.name: RubrovaIntegrationResilience
modules.role: shared durable incident register and safe error-handling helper for provider adapters

modules.name: RubrovaPaymentTerminals
modules.role: provider accounts, terminal configuration, caja/payment-method assignments, payment intents/attempts, refunds, provider events and settlement lines

modules.name: RubrovaReplenishmentExport
modules.role: authenticated read-only export of native MyCompany inventory, shipment commitments and expected receipts

acceptance: Complete pinned MyCompany and lsFusion source trees are committed in Rubrova
Retain Apache-2.0 and LGPL-3.0 license texts and source notices
Compile server, API, web client and MyCompany logic from the vendored source reactor
No upstream JAR/WAR or upstream logic image is used at runtime
Build offline from a prepared integrity-checked Maven repository
Run local runtime from Rubrova-built images with no image pulls or Internet egress
Validate POS search, receipt, payment, stock, refund, cash session and closure
Test clean installation, backup/restore and rollback before production
Load the RubrovaIntegrationResilience module and verify durable incident registration in an isolated database
Prove that an incident-log database failure falls back to local emergency logging without masking the original operation

dockerImages.note: Docker Hub metadata shows the MyCompany 6.2 logic image only for amd64, while lsFusion server/client 6.2 publish amd64 and arm64. A fully ARM64-native Compose stack is not established. AMD64 image digests are pinned for the Linux runtime smoke test; Apple Silicon is not treated as a native server target.

postgres.note: PostgreSQL 18 versioned PGDATA is persisted through the parent mount /var/lib/postgresql; Rubrova uses ./docker-db-pg18 and waits for pg_isready before starting lsFusion.

dockerImages.digestSource: Resolved from the official MyCompany 6.2 Compose, pulled and inspected by GitHub Actions runtime smoke test 44787405843 on 2026-11-20.
